fields.description: Never-written EEPROM header gap: all save I/O (FUN_0800a4b4 load, FUN_0800a574 validate, FUN_0800a52c store) roots reads/writes at EEPROM offset 4, so file bytes [0,4) stay erased 0xFF.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a4b4 sets uStack_1c=4 then FUN_08007404 0x170 bytes; FUN_0800a574 same base 4; FUN_0800a52c writes 0x170 bytes at base 4; baseline.sav logical bytes [0,4) are FF FF FF FF.
fields.name: header_gap_unused

fields.description: EEPROM save magic 0xD0D0DEAD (LE bytes AD DE D0 D0). Written by FUN_0800a52c from ROM word and validated by FUN_0800a4b4/FUN_0800a574 before a save is accepted.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a52c stores _DAT_0800a570 as buffer word 0 written at EEPROM offset 4 via FUN_080072ec; FUN_0800a4b4 requires aiStack_18c[0]==_DAT_0800a518; FUN_0800a574 same check vs _DAT_0800a5c8; baseline.sav logical [4,8) = AD DE D0 D0.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Skill/difficulty slot: first byte of the 8-byte live record (EEPROM offset 8). FUN_08022514 copies it into game state word *(_DAT_080225b0+0x8c). Default 2 matches the middle Doom skill index.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a4b4 reads 8 bytes at EEPROM offset 8 via FUN_08007404; FUN_08022514 stores byte 0 (bStack_28) to *(_DAT_080225b0+0x8c); FUN_0800a614 default param_1[0]=2; baseline.sav offset 8 = 0x02.
fields.name: profile_skill

fields.description: Sound engine parameter A: second live-record byte, applied at boot through FUN_0800bdc4 into the sound object (field +0x30 path). Constant 0x40 default also passed literally in the boot path.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022514 passes record byte 1 to FUN_0800bdc4 which calls FUN_080301ba on the sound object; boot code calls FUN_0800bdc4(0x40); FUN_0800a614 default param_1[1]=0x40; baseline.sav offset 9 = 0x40.
fields.name: sound_setting_a

fields.description: Sound engine parameter B: third live-record byte, applied at boot through FUN_0800bda4 (also latched at state +0x44). Default 0x10.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022514 passes record byte 2 to FUN_0800bda4 which calls FUN_0803016c and stores state+0x44; FUN_0800a614 default param_1[2]=0x10; baseline.sav offset 10 = 0x10.
fields.name: sound_setting_b

fields.description: Screen/display mode 0..3: fourth live-record byte selects one of four video/BG register setups in FUN_08006870; any other value is ignored.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022514 passes record byte 3 to FUN_08006870; FUN_08006870 switches on (param_1&0xff) with cases 0,1,2,3 programming the display register block at _DAT_08006888 and returns without action otherwise; FUN_0800a614 default param_1[3]=0; baseline.sav offset 11 = 0x00.
fields.name: screen_mode

fields.description: Profile config byte: fifth live-record byte, applied at boot into config struct field +8. Default 2.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022514 stores record byte 4 (bStack_24) to _DAT_080225ac field +8 after FUN_080028dc memsets 0xc bytes; FUN_0800a614 default param_1[4]=2; baseline.sav offset 12 = 0x02.
fields.name: profile_config

fields.description: Option flags: bit0 sets config struct bit2, bit1 selects the alt boot path (FUN_08015834 vs 08015840), bit2 sets status flag 8. Default 0x03.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022514 tests record byte 5 (bStack_23): bit0 ORs config bit2, bit1 chooses FUN_08015834 over func_0x08015840, bit2 ORs flag 8 into 0x080225e0; FUN_0800a614 default param_1[5]|=3; baseline.sav offset 13 = 0x03.
fields.name: option_flags

fields.description: Spare tail of the 8-byte live record: transferred by the EEPROM byte-granular I/O but never consumed by any routine; zero in the captured save.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a4b4 reads 8 bytes at EEPROM offset 8 via FUN_08007404 and FUN_08022514 consumes only bytes 0..5; baseline.sav logical [14,16) = 00 00.
fields.name: live_record_spare

fields.description: Reserved zero block: bulk payload of the checksummed save region. Written as memset zeros by the store path and covered by the checksum, but no decomp routine reads or interprets it; zero in the captured save.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a52c memsets 0x170 bytes and only FUN_0800a614 fills 6 bytes before FUN_080072ec writes at EEPROM base 4; FUN_0800a4b4/FUN_0800a574 read it only for magic+checksum validation; baseline.sav logical [0x10,0x170) all zero.
fields.name: reserved_zero_block

fields.description: Stored 16-bit checksum over logical save bytes [4,0x170), compared against FUN_08006b44 table-driven reflected CRC-16. Custom ROM table, so kept as a plain u16 field (value 0x24D3 in baseline).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a4b4 compares buffer word at save offset 0x170 (sStack_20 at buffer+364) with FUN_08006b44 checksum over 0x170 bytes; FUN_0800a52c stores FUN_08006b44 result at the same slot; baseline.sav logical [0x170,0x172) = D3 24.
fields.name: save_checksum16

fields.description: Never-written erased tail: the store path writes exactly 0x170 bytes at EEPROM base 4 (file range [4,0x174)), so bytes [0x174,0x200) stay erased 0xFF.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a52c writes 0x170 bytes at EEPROM offset 4 via FUN_080072ec; baseline.sav logical [0x174,0x200) all 0xFF while [0x172,0x174) are written zeros.
fields.name: trailing_erased

magic_signatures.description: EEPROM magic 0xD0D0DEAD LE at logical offset 4 (FUN_0800a52c writes it, FUN_0800a4b4/FUN_0800a574 validate it)
